observation.visible_scene: Interior of a wide-body aircraft cabin during a weightless (Zero-G) phase, shown through a fisheye lens. Several occupants in dark flight suits are suspended or resting on the padded floor. In the right foreground a woman floats near the wall holding a flexible (gorilla-pod style) tripod with a small camera and a clear plastic bag; in the center foreground a seated woman holds a phone up; on the left a woman is in a push-up pose on the floor; a man in a cap drifts near the left wall; other figures are scattered down the aisle. Banners reading 'Zero-G', 'SPACE', 'MICOS' and a blue 'Pancake' poster line the walls.
visible_changes: The central woman, already airborne with arms raised at the start, slowly ascends through the cabin, tucking her legs and by the last frames extending one arm upward toward the ceiling.
The right-side woman with the tripod and bag remains in roughly the same position, with only slight rotation and small shifts of her arms and the floating bag.
The seated foreground woman and the left push-up woman stay in essentially fixed poses, with minor head/body adjustments.
The man in the cap near the left wall and the background figures drift slightly but keep their general locations.
The fisheye frame shows a small overall drift/rotation, with wall panels and banners shifting position relative to the image edges.
outside_clip_unknowns: What initiated the central woman's upward motion (e.g., a push-off before the segment) and where she goes after the clip ends.
The exact phase of the parabolic flight and whether gravity is fully zero throughout.
The total number of occupants and any actions outside the visible frame.
uncertain_details: Whether the slight change in framing is camera motion or the camera itself floating; background evidence is limited.
The precise relative distances and identities of the more distant background figures due to the fisheye distortion.
Whether the plastic bag and tripod are being actively manipulated or simply drifting with the holder.
